reviews.x: This powder has probably been around since the '40's.  It is clean smelling, light, yummy.  I just smile when I puff it on.  I need to order more.  I use little else to make me feel dry and scented.  Live in the tropics so this powder is almost essential due to sweaty conditions. The plastic container is fun to keep for storing hairclips, rubber bands, jewelry or whatever.

I searched on the computer and found very few bath powder items available.  The  few available were very expensive.  I remember this brand from years ago and liked it then.  I really like the Jean Nate powder.  It smells so very good.
This is one of the most impressing items I owned. The (Discounted) price is very good. Quantity is big & it has its own puffing pad. I would order it again if stays at the same price.

reviews.t: Superb product, light scent, hard to find in stores.
reviews.x: This is THE BEST bath powder ever.  Light scent, not overwhelming.  Smooth fine talc, excellent quality.  Love it![[ASIN:B000MT1GHA Jean Nate Silkening Body Powder with Puff, Original 6 oz (170 g)]]

I've been using Jean Nate Bath Powder for over 60 years, and never have I found one that pleases so much.  The scent is a bit spicy, yet sweet; its feel is silky; and the smell is mild, not over powering.  My childhood neighbor's Mother  WAS JEAN NATE,, not that I'm biased :)

I've been looking for a body powder with no perfume because I'm allergic to perfume. I went through the reviews. Most people said it had a citrus smell and I knew I could tolerate citrus, just not floral, so I wanted to try it. It's been 45 years since I used Jean Nate products and have forgotten how they smell or why I stopped using them but I really can't understand the gritty comments about this powder because it is a very mild scent and not gritty at all. reviews.x: BEEN A CUSTOMER SINCE 1972, AND THIS FRAGRANCE HAS NOT CHANGED. BUT SADLY....DISCONTINUED. REVLON NO LONGER MAKING

I guess it will have to do until Revlon decides to make a bunch of 'baby boomers' like me - happy! The original Jean Nate was so unique - a soft, refreshing lemony smell. Have loved Jean Ǹate since my toddler years! My grandmother used it and she'd put a little powder on me after a bath! AND a deceased gay friend of mine used the after splash too!

reviews.t: A great hard to find gift for a nostalgic feel
reviews.x: My mom is 93 years old and it is really hard to find a gift she likes. When I was growing up she always had Jean Nate powder so I thought this would be a good gift for her. She was also wanting to find a powder canister that has a puff. I looked everywhere! I was even told they were against the law to sell because the puff can spread bacteria. (I have no idea if that is true, I don't know, and don't want to spread rumors). I ordered this just a few days ago and it arrived in time for Mother's Da

While browzing at Amazon, I started to look for talcum powder with a puff. Using a sprinkling can, I either get too much, or the holes fill up. When I saw Jean Nate under body powders I was delighted.  I forgot how I used it years ago and loved it.  I added one to my "cart" to buy when I had extra items. I forgot I had it in my cart so added it again during my next browzing session. When I received my order with two containers, I kept both since the price was right.  One is for me and other for

reviews.t: Good smell - but texture a little funny
reviews.x: No problems with the item, shipping, etc.  However, even thought this product smells very good it does not have the same silky texture as most powders.  It feels a little bit grainy.  I don't think I would repurchase it again.
When I received it, I wasn't expecting it to be big so I was surprised. For me, it was like a lemony fresh scent. I love it. Make you feel refresh. Definitely worth the price!
I used to love the clean fresh scent of Jean Nate but this was so strong, I choked on the scent.  I washed and dried the box and the puff and will try using it with some Burt's Bees powder.
It has an unpleasing fragrance --I remembered Jean Nate as smelling like lemons, but this is nothing like I remember.  Before you buy it, be sure tocheck out the fragrance.

It's a perfumed powder.  It comes in a perfect container, with nice pouf, and is scented beautifully.  I was introduced to this scent back in the 80's, and I find it's light scent, very appealing.  With any scented/perfumed powder, you risk irritation.  You don't know until you try it.  But, if you have sensitive skin then you should look for an unscented powder.  6 ounces is a lot of powder.  It's refreshing & light.  I'd definitely buy it again!

I looked into seven local area pharmacies and drug stores to no avail.  Jean Nate' has been my mother's scent "forever" -- gentle, soft, and comforting. I am so glad that she can continue to enjoy this body power for her 95th year.  Thanks!
Fragrance is very subtle, however, I have chemical sensitivities and it did not mix well with my immune system.  Sadly I cannot use it, but I did like the fragrance and will give it to my sister.
This scent takes me back to my high school days.  Along with Villager clothes, Aigner  purses, Bass Weejun shoes and Madras plaid accessories, this was a must have for the girls.

I debated whether or not to try this powder because the reviews were mixed.  But I loved Jean Nate in the 70's, and it was the one light fragrance I could tolerate, so I decided to try it again.  It's way too intensely smelly for me, and just having it in the house in its covered container was giving me a headache.  I took the top off and put it in a fabric bag and put in the garage to see if airing it out would get rid of some of the intensity.  So far, it hasn't helped and now my garage stinks

reviews.t: The Powder is Fine, but the Large Puff Falls Apart
reviews.x: I have loved Jean Nate for so many years that I expect it to be as great as it was in the '50s.  The scent is the same, but the powder puff used to be well made and didn't come apart after a few uses.  Since it is difficult to find where I now live, I ordered it from Amazon.com. I can recommend the powder, but find another well made large puff! I last used that puff to swipe-clean my bathroom counter of the powder dust; it did not hold up for body usage!

I've searched for Jean Nate for my Mom, who is 93 and thank goodness for the internet and Amazon.  I was able to buy 4 boxes for very reasonable prices.  My mother is staying at a great assisted living facility in Wilton Connecticut and she mentioned to her friends that I bought Jean Nate from Amazon and they are ready to order both for themselves and for the boutique store they have on premises.

The Jean Nate bath powder is a product that I have loved for years. Unfortunately it's difficult to find in stores in my area these days. Thinking it might have been discontinued, I decided to check Amazon, and there it was! I like the fact that the scent is clean and fresh and not sweet and overpowering. I'm sensitive to scents and this one is perfect for me.

claims.text: Reviewers widely praise the light, fresh scent, describing it as clean, lemony, and not overpowering.
Many customers are long-time, nostalgic users who have used the product for decades and appreciate its consistent fragrance.
Several reviewers note the product is hard to find in stores, making it a valued purchase or gift.
A few reviewers mention the texture or scent is not quite the same as the original, with one calling it grainy.
A small number of negative reviews cite the product being discontinued or expensive, and one raises a cancer concern about talc.
